channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: President Trump said on 20 November that the US will not allow its companies to build data centres abroad, or will put a tremendous tax on them if they do; no rate, scope or legal authority was given and nothing has been published. The BIS remote-access rule that took effect on 19 November is already biting: Nikkei reports at least two Nvidia server partners halted shipments to Southeast Asia and TSMC held some shipments to Chinese and non-Chinese designers while it checks the new 16nm and 14nm presumption. On 23 November Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, eleven days after he resigned, saying senior US government officials gave input that he poses no national security risk. Demand is not slowing at home: Applied Digital signed a 150 MW, 18-year hyperscaler lease at higher pricing. List prices held for an eleventh day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69.

item.title: Compute brief - 23 November 2026
item.description: President Trump said on 20 November that the US will not allow its companies to build data centres abroad, or will put a tremendous tax on them if they do; no rate, scope or legal authority was given and nothing has been published. The BIS remote-access rule that took effect on 19 November is already biting: Nikkei reports at least two Nvidia server partners halted shipments to Southeast Asia and TSMC held some shipments to Chinese and non-Chinese designers while it checks the new 16nm and 14nm presumption. On 23 November Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, eleven days after he resigned, saying senior US government officials gave input that he poses no national security risk. Demand is not slowing at home: Applied Digital signed a 150 MW, 18-year hyperscaler lease at higher pricing. List prices held for an eleventh day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69. Countries: United States: Trump threatens to block or tax US companies building data centres abroad (no order yet); Huang reinstated at Nvidia; Applied Digital 150 MW 18-year lease (Wire, 20 to 23 Nov). Taiwan: TSMC holds some shipments while it reviews the BIS 16nm and 14nm presumption (Wire, 20 Nov, single-source). Malaysia: At least two Nvidia server partners halt Southeast Asia shipments pending BIS licences; Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia also exposed (Wire, 20 Nov, single-source). Canada: Alberta Bill 42: AUC regulates data centres of 10 MW or more, 600 m setbacks, developer-paid wires (Wire, 18 Nov). Greece: AWS and PPC Kozani campus: 300 MW on a retired coal plant's 400 kV substations, 1 GW option (Wire, 23 Nov, single-source). India: L&T's LTN Compute wins a multi-year B300 order at Chennai for an inference provider; 250 MW phase one (Wire, 23 Nov).
